title: progressive.check_thresholds
description: Usage thresholds passed for a subscription (BE-PB-5..10). Thresholds are created on `attach`; plan_fixed_cents adds thresholds on the plan as well. Output: passed one-time thresholds ascending, and whether the recurring threshold passed.

plan_fixed_cents.description: One-time thresholds created on the subscription's plan in addition to `attach`. They follow BE-PB-5 precedence: with attach=subscription they apply only when the subscription has no threshold of its own (`fixed_cents` and `recurring_cents` empty); with attach=parent_plan the plan's thresholds replace the parent's; with attach=plan both lists are the plan's.
